visualReview.scope: Current authored presentation; maximum fidelity remains pending.
visualReview.notes: Inspected all 14 current portable and 14 shared frames in a labeled contact sheet, plus full-size shared base and cabin views. Concrete shaft bands are flush vertex tones, avoiding the earlier tiny groove shadow artifacts. Door recess, four cantilever platforms, gallery, 20-bay cabin and shortened two-stage mast render consistently. No bitmap images are embedded.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Three canonical shared graphs load once in the isolated fixture. Actual rendered geometry reaches 271888 triangles, bounds fit clipping and unload passes. This flat-terrain review does not certify site placement.

geographicReview.notes: Named physical tower way 476925020 is inside the exact-QID station parcel 295843613. Its mean ring center anchors this proposal. The mapped 17.6 m diameter disagrees with the original 24.38 m engineering base. Entrance and platform azimuth, terrain contact and current equipment bounds remain pending; no automatic placement is approved.

fidelityReview.notes: Maximum fidelity remains pending: current antenna segment dimensions and equipment inventory, exact entrance and platform shapes/locations, turret fabrication details, cable routes, site buildings and fences. Original Arup dimensions constrain the concrete tower, but modern radome segments are scaled from dated photographs and the reported 319 m height conflicts with operator text retaining 330.4 m. The 2011 lower-platform photographs establish structure, not a verified current dish inventory.
